items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Charles Lloyd used to come over, H. P. Barnum. Remember H. P. Barnum? Boy, was he something.

ctx.x: Can we go back? I was going to say, what happened after that concert, after your performance debut?

I realized either two things: I was either going to lay there on the floor, from getting decked like that, from that Sunday punch, and have everybody at school say, “See, I told you,” or I was going to get up off the canvas and make my mother proud. So me and Herbie, we started hanging out with Terry – what was Terry’s last name? He lived over in Glendale. We used to go over to his house and sit there and listen to records. Gee, I can’t remember the name. I can’t remember Terry’s name. You know what they say…
